page.overview:
Who is Amtosaurus?

is an extinct genus of ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous in what is now Mongolia. It lived in either a desert habitat or swamp habitat alongside Deinocheirus, Maleevus, Gobihadros, Achillobator, Graciliceratops, Erlikosaurus, and Segnosaurus. It also resembled its cousin so much that the species has been assigned to Amtosaurus at first.

Amtosaurus is mentioned in the database entry for the Baynshire Formation, the dig site for Deinocheirus in the game.

Amtosaurus is mentioned again in the database entry for the Baynshire Formation, the dig site for Deinocheirus.
